subject: Gateway bootstrap fold landed in ai-kit — three-lane UX contract in the awareness brief
result: For the desktop programme: ai-kit now ships the gateway as bootstrap-addressable product surface (commits f80d6fe + a2f90c9 on ai-kit main, not pushed).
